rules.statement: The appellant lacked the right to succeed as Viharadhipathy of Gothami Vihare.
rules.supporting_quote: That the District Judge was correct in his finding and that all the circumstances of the case show that appellant had no right to succeed as Viharadhipathy of Gothami Vihare

meta.parties: Sangapala Thero v. Telwatta Nagitha Thero
